reviews.author: ximinez
reviews.body:
This needs a little bit of reorganizing.

1. Split into two commits.
	1. The first only changes `features.macro`. Also write a better commit message. e.g. "Disable featureBatch and featureBatchInnerSigs amendments", and you can include the PR number since you have one now.
	2. The second changes the version number. The commit message will match previous version-setting commits: "Set version to X.Y.Z".
2. I also thought that this PR was going to set the version to "3.1.1-rc1", but if I'm wrong about that, nevermind.
